gloss: to sell off; to dispose of by selling

definitions.gloss: to sell off; to sell out; to dispose of (a large quantity) by selling
definitions.explanation: To sell goods—often a large quantity, leftover stock, or illicitly obtained items—until they are gone. Implies skillful or aggressive distribution, and is frequently used for clearing inventory or fencing stolen items.

examples.japanese: {在庫|ざいこ}を{売|う}りさばいた。
{犯人|はんにん}は{盗品|とうひん}をネットで{売|う}りさばいていた。
examples.english: The perpetrator was selling stolen goods online.

examples.japanese: {安|やす}く{仕入|しい}れた{商品|しょうひん}を{短期間|たんきかん}で{売|う}りさばいて{利益|りえき}を{上|あ}げた。
examples.english: We made a profit by selling off cheaply procured goods in a short period.

notes:
Compound of {売|う}る (to sell) + さばく (to handle, dispose of, work through). The さばく element conveys efficiency and completeness — selling through everything.

TRANSITIVITY:
Transitive. Takes a direct object marked with を: {商品|しょうひん}を{売|う}りさばく.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {在庫|ざいこ}を{売|う}りさばく: to sell off inventory
- {盗品|とうひん}を{売|う}りさばく: to fence stolen goods
- {商品|しょうひん}を{売|う}りさばく: to dispose of merchandise by selling
- {安|やす}く{売|う}りさばく: to sell off cheaply

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {売|う}る: to sell — neutral, no nuance of clearing or volume
- {売|う}り{切|き}る: to sell out — completion focus, often by seller's effort
- {処分|しょぶん}する: to dispose of — broader, includes discarding, not just selling
